_comment: Manual test setups for the `!test` chat command (devcmd.rs). Each: label, about, where to go (goto: a test target kind with an optional enemy/target name and number, or playfield with an optional pos; neither = stay here), team (minifigure names, first active; optional), spawn (enemies by name around you for 15 minutes, no respawn; optional).

scenarios.label: smash
scenarios.about: smashables next to you (smash animation timing, loot bags)

scenarios.label: chase
scenarios.about: a Musketeer camp in Pirate World that chases you (enemy movement)

scenarios.label: crowd
scenarios.about: 8 Pirate Corsairs around you where you stand (procs, buffs, area attacks)

scenarios.label: team
scenarios.about: Astronaut, Alien Trooper and Ballerina in the hub (animations, minifigure switching, health)

scenarios.label: kraken
scenarios.about: Crikey the Kraken's cave (boss that doesn't render)

scenarios.label: darkside
scenarios.about: Planet's Dark Side, where the client hung while loading
